source_text: VMMC's integration into broader prevention portfolios, alongside condoms and antiretrovirals, underscores its role as a one-time, cost-effective intervention, averting an estimated millions of infections, though debates over infant versus adult procedures and ethical promotion in diverse cultural contexts highlight ongoing tensions between evidence-based public health and individual autonomy. [11]
